# Map-setup eligibility, not a generic engine government preflight.
# RH/WH/unknown holdings and AGOT/LoV dummy holders retain their own lifecycle.
aawc_setup_tribal_county_eligible = {
	is_capital_barony = yes
	exists = holder
	holder = {
		agot_is_dummy_character = no
		exists = primary_title
		primary_title = { is_landless_type_title = no }
	}
	title_province = {
		has_holding = yes
		NOR = {
			has_holding_type = ruin_holding
			has_holding_type = wilderness_holding
			has_holding_type = unknown_holding
		}
	}
}
